checks.item: Checker does not silently skip fields behind comments
checks.evidence: orchestration/evidence/tmp-T8.6/mut2.py: adding 'public int zzz; // secret' to Card is NOT reported (MISSED). FIELD_RE (tools/check_unity_schema.py line 21) only allows a trailing '// enum:' comment, so any other trailing comment makes the line unmatched and the field is dropped from parsing. The same happens for '[SerializeField] int zzz;' / '[SerializeField] private int zzz;' (JsonUtility serializes these, so they would go on the wire). A trailing comment on an existing field shows as a false 'missing', so only extra fields slip through.

checks.item: Checker covers nullable/required mismatch and defaults

Enum values are only compared against '// enum:' comments, which the C# never enforces. tests/test_unity_schema.py covers only missing, extra, type and enum; there are no tests for the type constant or any of the above.

checks.item: Button press from XR simulator or controller is wired
checks.evidence: ContextLensClient.PollController reads UnityEngine.XR.InputDevices (CommonUsages.primaryButton). That works for a headset controller exposed through an XR provider. docs/unity-setup.md step 9 and the code comment claim the XR Device Simulator 'drives the same input', but the XR Interaction Toolkit simulator creates Input System devices, which UnityEngine.XR.InputDevices does not list (my inference, not verifiable here; the doc itself says 'Not tested'). Packages/manifest.json also has no com.unity.xr.interaction.toolkit or com.unity.inputsystem. The task asks for a press from the simulator or a controller; the simulator path is unsubstantiated and there is no committed scene that would use it.

Fake server start and the Active Input Handling setting are present. Missing: the exact XRI package name/version and steps to add it (step 9 only says 'add the XR Interaction Toolkit'), and the fact that adding XRI pulls in the Input System (which then needs Active Input Handling = Both). Step 6 says Pause changes the indicator to 'Not recording (paused)' but docs/client-contract.md lists pause as '(no reply)'; only tools/fake_server.py sends status paused (lines 135-137), so against a contract-only backend the indicator would stay 'REC' after Pause. Packages versions: com.unity.ugui 2.0.0 matches Unity 6 editor bundled projects (grep of editor package folder); modules xr/audio/ui/etc exist in BuiltInPackages.
